info.title: Ti Phase 4C Learning Transaction-Write Compatibility Delta
info.description: Self-contained Java overlay for nine legacy transaction-write operations. Implementations and real execution evidence exist; operations remain pending until the fixed successor and route promotion gates close. Production cutover is disabled.

QuestionId.description: Unicode Nd decimal segment normalized losslessly to a non-negative signed 64-bit identifier.

RateRemaining.description: Requests remaining in the current fixed window.

RateReset.description: Unix epoch second at which the current window resets.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds until the current window resets.

AuthenticationRequired.description: No accepted credential could authenticate the actor.

Forbidden.description: Safety/authorization denial, or a bodyless CORS rejection before authentication.

NotFound.description: Question or identity was not found.

Conflict.description: The idempotency key conflicts with the first request or its first transaction is still in progress.

RateLimited.description: The route or authentication fixed window is exhausted.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Authentication authority or Redis is unavailable.

PreflightAccepted.description: Allowed CORS preflight; no authentication or rate charge.
